entries.name: Oni (鬼)
entries.description: Horned, iron-club-wielding ogre of Japanese folklore, often a demon of hell or the northeast "demon gate".

entries.name: Kitsune (狐)
entries.description: Fox spirit that gains tails and magic with age and can take human form; messenger of Inari.

entries.name: Tsuru (鶴)
entries.description: Red-crowned crane, a symbol of longevity and fidelity.

entries.name: Kappa (河童)
entries.description: River imp with a water-filled dish on its head; drowns careless swimmers, loves cucumbers, must be polite.

entries.name: Karasu-tengu (烏天狗)
entries.description: Crow-beaked mountain goblin, martial-arts master and trickster of the peaks.

entries.name: Tanuki (狸)
entries.description: Shape-shifting raccoon dog famed for leaf-magic and a belly drum.

entries.name: Bakeneko (化け猫)
entries.description: Cat that grows into a shape-shifting, speaking, sometimes corpse-animating ghost cat.

entries.name: Nurikabe (塗り壁)
entries.description: Invisible wall that blocks travellers on dark roads at night.

entries.name: Yuki-onna (雪女)
entries.description: Pale snow woman who appears in blizzards and freezes travellers.

entries.name: Rokurokubi (ろくろ首)
entries.description: Woman whose neck stretches at night, often unaware of it herself.

entries.name: Jorōgumo (女郎蜘蛛)
entries.description: Spider that becomes a seductive woman to trap men in its web.

entries.name: Kodama (木霊)
entries.description: Spirit that dwells in old trees; felling its tree brings misfortune.

entries.name: Komainu (狛犬)
entries.description: Paired lion-dog statues guarding shrine gates.

entries.name: Baku (獏)
entries.description: Tapir-like chimera that eats nightmares.

entries.name: Yamata no Orochi (八岐大蛇)
entries.description: Eight-headed, eight-tailed serpent slain by Susanoo in the Kojiki.

entries.name: Nue (鵺)
entries.description: Chimera with a monkey's face, tanuki body, tiger limbs and snake tail; its cry brings illness.

entries.name: Nekomata (猫又)
entries.description: Cat with a forked tail, an elder form of the bakeneko of mountain lore.

entries.name: Kasa-obake (傘お化け)
entries.description: Aged umbrella that comes alive with one eye and one leg (a tsukumogami).

entries.name: Chōchin-obake (提灯お化け)
entries.description: Old paper lantern come alive, with a gaping mouth and lolling tongue.

entries.name: Hitotsume-kozō (一つ目小僧)
entries.description: One-eyed child-monk prankster that startles passers-by.

entries.name: Gashadokuro (がしゃどくろ)
entries.description: Giant skeleton formed from the unburied war dead, said to bite off heads.

entries.name: Kamaitachi (鎌鼬)
entries.description: Whirlwind weasel with sickle claws that cuts skin without pain.

entries.name: Tsuchigumo (土蜘蛛)
entries.description: Giant earth spider of legend, slain by Minamoto no Raikō.

entries.name: Ittan-momen (一反木綿)
entries.description: Strip of flying cloth that wraps around and smothers people at night.

entries.name: Noppera-bō (のっぺら坊)
entries.description: Faceless ghost that frightens travellers by wiping its face blank.

entries.name: Umibōzu (海坊主)
entries.description: Black giant rising from the sea to capsize ships.

entries.name: Ōnamazu (大鯰)
entries.description: Giant catfish beneath Japan whose thrashing causes earthquakes.

entries.name: Inugami (犬神)
entries.description: Dog spirit used in curses, from Shikoku and Kyushu folklore.

entries.name: Zashiki-warashi (座敷童)
entries.description: Child spirit of old houses in Tohoku that brings fortune to the family.

entries.name: Yamabiko (山彦)
entries.description: Mountain echo given a dog-like body, answering calls from the peaks.

entries.name: Shachihoko (鯱)
entries.description: Tiger-headed carp ornament on castle roofs, said to protect against fire.

entries.name: Raijū (雷獣)
entries.description: Lightning beast that rides storms and sleeps in belly buttons of folklore.

entries.name: Sphinx
entries.description: Lion-bodied guardian with a royal human head.

entries.name: Mummy
entries.description: Preserved, bandaged corpse that rises to guard its tomb.

entries.name: Nile crocodile
entries.description: Feared and venerated river predator.

entries.name: Hippopotamus
entries.description: Dangerous river beast, associated with Set and Taweret.

entries.name: Anubis (Inpu)
entries.description: Jackal-headed god of embalming who guides the dead and weighs hearts.

entries.name: Ra
entries.description: Falcon-headed sun god who sails the sky and underworld in his barque.

entries.name: Bastet
entries.description: Cat-headed protector goddess of the home.

entries.name: Thoth (Djehuty)
entries.description: Ibis- or baboon-headed god of writing and wisdom.

entries.name: Osiris
entries.description: Mummiform king of the underworld, god of resurrection.

entries.name: Isis (Aset)
entries.description: Winged goddess of magic and motherhood.

entries.name: Scarab beetle
entries.description: Dung beetle symbolising rebirth.

entries.name: Horus (Heru)
entries.description: Falcon-headed sky god and avenger of Osiris, whose eye is a protective symbol.

entries.name: Sekhmet
entries.description: Lioness-headed war goddess, Eye of Ra, bringer of plague.

entries.name: Sobek
entries.description: Crocodile-headed god of the Nile and fertility.

entries.name: Set
entries.description: God of storm and chaos with an unidentified "Set animal" head.

entries.name: Apep (Apophis)
entries.description: Giant chaos serpent that attacks Ra's barque each night.

entries.name: Ammit
entries.description: Crocodile, lion and hippo composite that devours unworthy hearts.

entries.name: Bes
entries.description: Dwarf lion-featured household protector who wards off evil.

entries.name: Bennu
entries.description: Heron-like bird of Heliopolis, the model for the phoenix.

entries.name: Wadjet
entries.description: Cobra goddess of Lower Egypt, the royal uraeus.

entries.name: Ushabti
entries.description: Funerary figurine meant to work for the dead in the afterlife.

entries.name: Medjed
entries.description: Shrouded figure with only eyes visible, from the Book of the Dead.

entries.name: Sacred ibis
entries.description: Wading bird of Thoth, mummified in the millions.

entries.name: Hathor
entries.description: Cow-eared goddess of love, music and joy, mother of the king.

entries.name: Amun (Amun-Ra)
entries.description: Hidden king of the gods at Thebes, ram-linked, later merged with Ra.

entries.name: Maat
entries.description: Winged goddess of truth, justice and cosmic order whose feather weighs hearts.

entries.name: Khepri
entries.description: Scarab-headed form of the rising sun.

entries.name: Serket (Selket)
entries.description: Scorpion goddess who protects against venom.

entries.name: Taweret
entries.description: Hippo-bodied protector of mothers and childbirth.

entries.name: Serpopard
entries.description: Serpent-necked leopard from the Narmer Palette and early art.

entries.name: Ba
entries.description: Human-headed bird form of the soul.

entries.name: Ptah
entries.description: Mummiform craftsman god of Memphis who created the world by speech.

entries.name: Nephthys
entries.description: Goddess of mourning, sister of Isis, with a house-and-basket crown.

entries.name: Nut
entries.description: Sky goddess arched over the earth, who swallows the sun each evening.

entries.name: Geb
entries.description: Earth god, father of Osiris, whose laughter was said to cause earthquakes.

entries.name: Khnum
entries.description: Ram-headed potter god who shapes people on his wheel at Elephantine.

entries.name: Neith
entries.description: Warrior and weaver goddess of Sais with crossed arrows.

entries.name: Atum
entries.description: Self-created primordial god of Heliopolis, the "complete one".

entries.name: Aten
entries.description: Sun disc with rays ending in hands, worshipped under Akhenaten.

entries.name: Khonsu
entries.description: Moon god, a youthful figure with a side-lock, travelling across the night sky.

entries.name: Mehen
entries.description: Coiled serpent that shelters Ra in his barque on the night journey.

entries.name: Nehebkau
entries.description: Two-headed snake deity who guards the dead.

entries.name: Akhekh
entries.description: Griffin-like creature with a serpent's neck in funerary texts.

entries.name: Shu
entries.description: God of air who holds up the sky goddess Nut.

entries.name: Tefnut
entries.description: Lioness-headed goddess of moisture, twin of Shu.

entries.name: Long (龍)
entries.description: Chinese dragon: wingless, rain- and river-bringing, with a pearl.

entries.name: Giant panda (大熊貓)
entries.description: Bamboo-eating bear, national emblem of China.

entries.name: Fenghuang (鳳凰)
entries.description: "Phoenix": composite bird of virtue that appears in peaceful reigns.

entries.name: Qilin (麒麟)
entries.description: Hooved chimera with scaled body, whose appearance is a good omen.

entries.name: Jiangshi (殭屍)
entries.description: Stiff, hopping corpse that drains qi from the living.

entries.name: Red-crowned crane (丹頂鶴)
entries.description: Symbol of longevity, carries immortals in art.

entries.name: Koi / carp (鯉)
entries.description: Carp that leaps the Dragon Gate to become a dragon.

entries.name: Nian (年)
entries.description: Beast that preys on villages at New Year and fears red and noise.

entries.name: Taotie (饕餮)
entries.description: Gluttonous maw-faced beast of Zhou bronzes.

entries.name: Pixiu (貔貅)
entries.description: Winged lion-like beast that eats wealth and never lets it leave.

entries.name: Yutu (玉兔)
entries.description: Jade Rabbit that pounds the elixir of life on the moon.

entries.name: Jiuweihu (九尾狐)
entries.description: Nine-tailed fox, omen of peace or a seductive fiend depending on source.

entries.name: Kunpeng (鯤鵬)
entries.description: Vast fish that becomes a bird thousands of li across (Zhuangzi).

entries.name: Hundun (混沌)
entries.description: Faceless, shapeless being, a figure of primordial chaos.

entries.name: Qiongqi (窮奇)
entries.description: Winged tiger (or ox) from the Classic of Mountains and Seas.

entries.name: Bai Ze (白澤)
entries.description: Wise many-eyed beast who knows all spirits and told them to Huangdi.

entries.name: Jingwei (精衛)
entries.description: Drowned girl turned bird who fills the sea with pebbles.

entries.name: Kui (夔)
entries.description: One-legged hornless ox whose roar is thunder.

entries.name: Xiangliu (相柳)
entries.description: Nine-headed snake whose poisonous breath ruins land.

entries.name: Bifang (畢方)
entries.description: One-legged crane whose appearance foretells fire.

entries.name: Xingtian (刑天)
entries.description: Headless warrior with eyes on the chest who fights on.

entries.name: Hulijing (狐狸精)
entries.description: Fox spirit that becomes a woman; related to the nine-tailed fox.

entries.name: Bashe (巴蛇)
entries.description: Giant snake said to swallow an elephant and spit out its bones.

entries.name: Xiezhi (獬豸)
entries.description: One-horned ox-goat that butts the guilty.

entries.name: Bixi (贔屭)
entries.description: Dragon-headed tortoise that carries stone steles.

entries.name: Chiwen (螭吻)
entries.description: Dragon-fish roof ornament that wards off fire.

entries.name: Shanxiao (山魈)
entries.description: One-legged mountain imp that causes fever and mischief.

entries.name: Medusa
entries.description: Gorgon with snake hair whose gaze turns people to stone.

entries.name: Cyclops (Kyklops)
entries.description: One-eyed giant smith or shepherd, as in the Odyssey.

entries.name: Cerberus
entries.description: Multi-headed hound guarding the gates of Hades.

entries.name: Hydra of Lerna
entries.description: Many-headed water serpent whose heads regrow.

entries.name: Griffin (Gryps)
entries.description: Eagle-headed winged lion that guards gold.

entries.name: Pegasus
entries.description: Winged horse born from Medusa's blood.

entries.name: Siren
entries.description: Bird-bodied singer who lures sailors onto the rocks.

entries.name: Centaur
entries.description: Horse-bodied man; Chiron was a wise teacher among wild kin.

entries.name: Zeus
entries.description: King of the gods, wielder of the thunderbolt.

entries.name: Poseidon
entries.description: God of the sea, earthquakes and horses.

entries.name: Hades
entries.description: Lord of the underworld, with his helm of invisibility.

entries.name: Athena
entries.description: Goddess of wisdom and war, with her owl.

entries.name: Dolphin
entries.description: Friendly sea mammal, sacred to Apollo and Dionysus.

entries.name: Apollo
entries.description: God of the sun, music, prophecy and the Pythian oracle.

entries.name: Artemis
entries.description: Virgin huntress, goddess of the moon, wild animals and childbirth.

entries.name: Aphrodite
entries.description: Goddess of love and beauty, born from sea foam.

entries.name: Hermes
entries.description: Winged messenger and trickster, guide of souls and patron of travellers.

entries.name: Dionysus
entries.description: God of wine, theatre and ecstatic revelry.

entries.name: Minotaur
entries.description: Bull-headed man of the Cretan labyrinth.

entries.name: Chimera
entries.description: Lion with a goat head on its back and a snake tail, breathing fire.

entries.name: Harpy
entries.description: Winged woman-bird snatching food and people.

entries.name: Satyr
entries.description: Goat-legged follower of Dionysus, piper and reveller.

entries.name: Scylla
entries.description: Six-headed sea monster of the strait opposite Charybdis.

entries.name: Nemean Lion
entries.description: Lion with an invulnerable hide killed by Heracles.

entries.name: Charybdis
entries.description: Whirlpool monster who swallows and spews the sea thrice daily.

entries.name: Dryad
entries.description: Tree nymph whose life is tied to her tree.

entries.name: Charon
entries.description: Ferryman who carries the dead across the Styx.

entries.name: Pan
entries.description: Goat-legged god of the wild, flocks and sudden panic.

entries.name: Hera
entries.description: Queen of the gods, goddess of marriage, jealous wife of Zeus.

entries.name: Ares
entries.description: God of war and bloodshed, hated by his fellow Olympians.

entries.name: Hephaestus
entries.description: Lame smith god who forged the weapons and automata of the gods.

entries.name: Demeter
entries.description: Goddess of grain and the harvest, mother of Persephone.

entries.name: Persephone
entries.description: Queen of the underworld who spends part of each year with Hades.

entries.name: Hecate
entries.description: Goddess of crossroads, witchcraft and ghosts, bearing torches.

entries.name: Prometheus
entries.description: Titan who stole fire for humankind and was chained to a rock.

entries.name: Atlas
entries.description: Titan condemned to hold up the sky.

entries.name: Eros
entries.description: Winged god of desire whose arrows kindle love.

entries.name: Talos
entries.description: Bronze giant who guards Crete by circling the island.

entries.name: Typhon
entries.description: Hundred-headed storm giant, father of monsters.

entries.name: Echidna
entries.description: Half-woman, half-snake mother of many monsters.

entries.name: Ladon
entries.description: Hundred-headed dragon guarding the Hesperides' golden apples.

entries.name: Stymphalian birds
entries.description: Man-eating birds with bronze beaks and metal feathers.

entries.name: Erymanthian Boar
entries.description: Giant boar of the Arcadian mountains.

entries.name: Cretan Bull
entries.description: Raging white bull Heracles captured, sire of the Minotaur.

entries.name: Lamia
entries.description: Child-snatching queen turned monster by Hera.

entries.name: Hippocampus
entries.description: Fish-tailed sea horse that pulls Poseidon's chariot.

entries.name: Triton
entries.description: Merman herald of the sea who blows a conch.

entries.name: Nereid
entries.description: Sea nymph, daughter of Nereus.

entries.name: Graeae
entries.description: Three grey sisters sharing one eye and one tooth.

entries.name: Owl of Athena
entries.description: Little owl, symbol of wisdom and Athens.

entries.name: Hestia
entries.description: Virgin goddess of the hearth and domestic fire.

entries.name: Cronus
entries.description: Titan who castrated Uranus and swallowed his own children.

entries.name: Gaia
entries.description: Primordial earth, mother of the Titans and Giants.

entries.name: Thanatos
entries.description: Winged personification of death, brother of Hypnos.

entries.name: Hypnos
entries.description: Personification of sleep who dwells near the underworld.

entries.name: Nemesis
entries.description: Goddess of retribution against arrogance.

entries.name: Eris
entries.description: Goddess of strife who threw the golden apple at the wedding of Peleus.

entries.name: Orthrus
entries.description: Two-headed hound of Geryon, Cerberus's brother.

entries.name: Empusa
entries.description: Shape-shifting, bronze-legged demon sent by Hecate.

entries.name: Python
entries.description: Serpent of Delphi slain by Apollo.

entries.name: Argus Panoptes
entries.description: Hundred-eyed giant herdsman who never fully sleeps.

entries.name: Ram Chrysomallos
entries.description: Golden-fleeced flying ram sought by the Argonauts.

entries.name: Nyx
entries.description: Primordial goddess of night, mother of Sleep and Death.

entries.name: Helios
entries.description: Sun god who drives a chariot across the sky each day.

entries.name: Selene
entries.description: Moon goddess driving a silver chariot.

entries.name: Valkyrie
entries.description: Armoured chooser of the slain who bears warriors to Valhalla.

entries.name: Troll
entries.description: Mountain-dwelling giant or brute, turned to stone by sunlight in folk tales.

entries.name: Kraken
entries.description: Giant sea creature of later Scandinavian sailors' tales.

entries.name: Thor
entries.description: God of thunder, goat-driver, wielder of Mjölnir.

entries.name: Odin
entries.description: The All-father, one-eyed wanderer.

entries.name: Loki
entries.description: Trickster and shape-shifter, mother of Sleipnir.

entries.name: Polar bear
entries.description: Arctic apex predator of the Norse coasts and Greenland.

entries.name: Reindeer
entries.description: Hardy herd animal of the Nordic north.

entries.name: Wolf
entries.description: Pack hunter of the Nordic forests.

entries.name: Fenrir
entries.description: Monstrous wolf bound by the gods, fated to break loose at Ragnarök.

entries.name: Jörmungandr
entries.description: World Serpent encircling Midgard, doomed to fight Thor at Ragnarök.

entries.name: Draugr
entries.description: Undead barrow-dweller of strength and foul temper that guards its treasure.

entries.name: Freyja
entries.description: Goddess of love and war, drawn with her cats.

entries.name: Hel
entries.description: Half-living, half-corpse ruler of the realm of the dead.

entries.name: Sleipnir
entries.description: Eight-legged grey horse of Odin, born of Loki.

entries.name: Jötunn
entries.description: Frost giant, ancient foe of gods and men.

entries.name: Surtr
entries.description: Fire giant of Muspelheim who will burn the world at Ragnarök.

entries.name: Dvergr
entries.description: Dwarf smith who forges treasures within the earth.

entries.name: Níðhöggr
entries.description: Dragon that gnaws the roots of Yggdrasil.

entries.name: Ratatoskr
entries.description: Squirrel that carries insults up and down Yggdrasil.

entries.name: Huginn and Muninn
entries.description: Odin's two ravens, Thought and Memory.

entries.name: Lindworm
entries.description: Wingless, two-legged serpent dragon of Nordic folklore.

entries.name: Nisse
entries.description: Small house gnome who guards the farm and punishes disrespect.

entries.name: Garmr
entries.description: Blood-stained hound that guards Hel's gate.

entries.name: Fáfnir
entries.description: Dwarf turned dragon who guards a cursed hoard.

entries.name: Freyr
entries.description: Vanir god of fertility, sunshine and prosperity who owns the boar Gullinbursti.

entries.name: Baldr
entries.description: Beloved god of light killed by a mistletoe dart through Loki's scheme.

entries.name: Tyr
entries.description: One-handed god of law and war who lost his hand binding Fenrir.

entries.name: Heimdall
entries.description: Watchman of the gods at the rainbow bridge who will sound the Gjallarhorn.

entries.name: Frigg
entries.description: Queen of Asgard, wife of Odin, who foresees all but tells nothing.

entries.name: Sköll and Hati
entries.description: Wolves that chase the sun and moon.

entries.name: Gullinbursti
entries.description: Golden-bristled boar made by dwarves.

entries.name: Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjóstr
entries.description: Goats that pull a chariot and can be eaten and revived.

entries.name: Auðumbla
entries.description: Primordial cow who licked the first god from the ice.

entries.name: Huldra
entries.description: Alluring forest woman with a cow's tail, from Scandinavian folklore.

entries.name: Näcken
entries.description: Fiddling water spirit who lures people into lakes.

entries.name: Draugen
entries.description: Headless fisherman's ghost who rows a half boat before storms.

entries.name: Mara
entries.description: Night spirit that sits on sleepers' chests and brings nightmares.

entries.name: Skogsrå
entries.description: Hollow-backed forest-keeper woman of Swedish folklore.

entries.name: Njörðr
entries.description: Vanir god of the sea, ships and wealth.

entries.name: Iðunn
entries.description: Keeper of the apples that keep the gods young.

entries.name: Sif
entries.description: Golden-haired wife of Thor.

entries.name: Skaði
entries.description: Giantess goddess of winter, skiing and the hunt.

entries.name: Ægir
entries.description: Jötunn lord of the sea who brews ale for the gods.

entries.name: Mímir
entries.description: Wise being whose severed head Odin consults beside a well of wisdom.

entries.name: Norns
entries.description: Three fate-weavers beneath Yggdrasil: Urðr, Verðandi and Skuld.

entries.name: Eikþyrnir
entries.description: Stag atop Valhalla whose antlers drip rivers.

entries.name: Hræsvelgr
entries.description: Giant eagle at the world's edge whose wings stir the winds.

entries.name: Haugbui
entries.description: Barrow-dweller, a mound-guarding variant of the draugr.

entries.name: Bragi
entries.description: God of poetry and eloquence.

entries.name: Víðarr
entries.description: Silent god who avenges Odin at Ragnarök by slaying Fenrir.

entries.name: Höðr
entries.description: Blind god tricked into killing Baldr.

entries.name: Ullr
entries.description: God of archery, skiing and the duel.

entries.name: Grey Wolf
entries.description: Helper and menace of Slavic folk tales.

entries.name: Brown bear
entries.description: Lord of the forest, Russia's emblem animal.

entries.name: Baba Yaga
entries.description: Witch who flies in a mortar and lives in a hut on chicken legs.

entries.name: Firebird (Zhar-ptitsa)
entries.description: Glowing bird whose feathers light the night.

entries.name: Koschei
entries.description: The Deathless sorcerer whose death is hidden in a needle in an egg.

entries.name: Zmey Gorynych
entries.description: Multi-headed fire-breathing dragon of the byliny.

entries.name: Leshy
entries.description: Shape-shifting master of the forest who leads travellers astray.

entries.name: Rusalka
entries.description: Drowned maiden who lures the living into rivers.

entries.name: Vodyanoy
entries.description: Frog-bearded water spirit who drowns the careless.

entries.name: Domovoi
entries.description: Hairy household guardian who tends or punishes the home.

entries.name: Upyr
entries.description: Slavic vampire, a corpse that rises to feed on the living.

entries.name: Vila
entries.description: Storm and mountain fairy-maiden, kind or cruel.

entries.name: Mavka
entries.description: Ukrainian forest nymph, a dead girl who lures men.

entries.name: Wisent
entries.description: European bison of Białowieża, the old forest.

entries.name: Kikimora
entries.description: Mischievous swamp or house spirit that spins at night.

entries.name: Bannik
entries.description: Spirit of the bathhouse, dangerous when angered.

entries.name: Poludnitsa
entries.description: Noon lady of the fields who punishes those working in the heat.

entries.name: Likho
entries.description: One-eyed embodiment of misfortune.

entries.name: Alkonost
entries.description: Bird with a maiden's face whose song makes people forget all.

entries.name: Strzyga
entries.description: Two-souled night demon of Polish folklore.

entries.name: Sirin
entries.description: Owl-bodied woman-bird whose song is deadly to hear.

entries.name: Gamayun
entries.description: Prophetic bird with a woman's face.

entries.name: Simargl
entries.description: Winged dog guardian of seeds in early Rus lore.

entries.name: Indrik
entries.description: Horned beast-king of animals in Russian legend.

entries.name: Drekavac
entries.description: Dreaded screaming creature of Serbian and Croatian folklore.

entries.name: Vukodlak
entries.description: Werewolf-vampire of the Balkan Slavs.

entries.name: Sivka-Burka
entries.description: Magical talking horse of Russian folk tales.

entries.name: Ovinnik
entries.description: Barn spirit that lives in the grain-drying house.

entries.name: Polevik
entries.description: Field spirit that tricks farmers in the crops.

entries.name: Zduhać
entries.description: Serbian weather guardian born with a caul who fights storm dragons.

entries.name: Rarog
entries.description: Fiery falcon of Slavic tales, tied to the Rurikid emblem.

entries.name: Aspid
entries.description: Winged poisonous serpent of Russian bestiaries.

entries.name: Jaguar
entries.description: Apex predator and royal emblem of the Maya.

entries.name: Resplendent quetzal
entries.description: Long-tailed forest bird of the cloud forests.

entries.name: Spider monkey
entries.description: Agile canopy monkey of Central America.

entries.name: Tapir
entries.description: Shy forest herbivore with a short trunk.

entries.name: Camazotz
entries.description: Death bat who beheaded a Hero Twin in Xibalba.

entries.name: Ocellated turkey
entries.description: Colourful forest turkey of the Yucatán.

entries.name: Vucub Caquix
entries.description: Seven Macaw, false sun slain by the Hero Twins.

entries.name: Zipacna
entries.description: Crocodile-backed mountain-maker giant of the Popol Vuh.

entries.name: Cabrakan
entries.description: Earthquake giant who topples mountains.

entries.name: Balam
entries.description: Jaguar guardian of fields and villages.

entries.name: Alux
entries.description: Little field and forest sprite of Yucatec folklore.

entries.name: Sisimito
entries.description: Hairy forest giant of Maya folklore.

entries.name: Xtabay
entries.description: Ceiba-tree spirit that lures men in the forest.

entries.name: Huay Chivo

families.name: Dragons and great serpents
families.trait: Big hide, one signature breath or coil attack, a hoard that drops loot.

families.name: Undead and revenants
families.trait: Rise again unless the body is dealt with (fire, charm, burial).

families.name: Ghosts and wailing spirits
families.trait: Pass through blockers; strike with fear or cold; weak to being named or honoured.

families.name: Household and object spirits
families.trait: Live in a place or thing; helpful when fed, vicious when slighted.

families.name: Giants and ogres
families.trait: Huge, slow, throw things; fill several tiles.

families.name: Demons and devils
families.trait: Curses and fear instead of brute force; summoned by name.

families.name: Goblins, imps and little folk
families.trait: Small, quick, steal or swap things; come in groups.

families.name: Shapeshifters
families.trait: Change shape when hurt or on a timer; reveal the true form when struck.

families.name: Tricksters
families.trait: Swap places, steal an item, fake a danger; hard to pin down.

families.name: Water-folk and river spirits
families.trait: Fight from water tiles; drag pieces under; fear dry ground.

families.name: Sea monsters
families.trait: Lurk offshore, raise waves, wreck ships.

families.name: Birds and winged beasts
families.trait: Fly over blockers; dive from above; weak to wind and nets.

families.name: Hounds and wolves
families.trait: Hunt in packs; tracking and surround attacks.

families.name: Cats
families.trait: Ambush, pounce from cover, climb.

families.name: Insects, spiders and scorpions
families.trait: Come in numbers; poison; weak to fire.

families.name: Plants, trees and fungi
families.trait: Rooted; regrow while the tile is green; weak to fire.

families.name: Constructs and golems
families.trait: Slow to wake, hard to hurt, follow orders.

families.name: Guardian beasts
families.trait: Block a gate or hoard; harmless until approached.

families.name: Chimeras and hybrids
families.trait: Mixed bodies with several attack types.

families.name: Beast-men and wild men
families.trait: Upright, strong, shy; live at the edge of settlements.

families.name: Hags, witches and lures
families.trait: Seduce or deceive; the true form is a trap.

families.name: Elementals and storm beasts
families.trait: Bring weather or fire; strongest in their element.

families.name: Horned and hoofed beasts
families.trait: Charge, trample, move in herds.

families.name: Death omens and psychopomps
families.trait: Announce or collect the dead; heard before seen.

families.name: Lake monsters and cryptids
families.trait: Sightings only; appear then vanish.

families.name: Swarms and vermin
families.trait: Many weak bodies; split when hit.

families.name: Real beasts
families.trait: Plain animals with no magic; fillers and herd monsters, usually grouped by habitat in the terrain index.

Examples by culture: Brown bear (Norse and Slavic); Siberian tiger

families.name: Celestial figures
families.trait: Time-bound; strongest at a fixed hour or phase; also useful as set bosses.
